description: This file implements a listener management module for handling event subscriptions, including registration, unregistration, and disposal of event listeners, with external API calls for non-internal events.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the event listener and unregisters it if no other listeners remain.

methods.name: makeListenerId
methods.description: Constructs a unique identifier for a listener based on plugin and event.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific plugin and event, making an API request if necessary.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a listener for a specific plugin and event, making an API request if necessary.
